scope: Retain all 48 cells, eight triggered checkpoints and all twelve original candidates; no outcome-based exclusions.
Deterministic code diffs, exact changed old lines, all public/evaluator outcomes, gains and regressions from saved results; no model execution or API calls.
Inspect all generated artifacts and paired wins/losses, including invalid outputs, public acceptance gaps and five never-repaired bugs.
Separate artifact/test facts, analyst semantic interpretation and untested mechanism hypotheses; line overlap cannot establish model attention or cause.
Propose one falsifiable diagnostic ablation and independent validation design; do not conduct a new collection or train a selector.
private_outcome_boundary: Evaluator cases may explain retrospective failures only; never become public acquisition input or an unseen validation claim.
limits: Post hoc, aggregate-known, exposed development cases concentrated in two projects.
Mechanisms cannot be causally identified from existing two-arm observations.
No relaxed gate, repeated bank, pooled historical controls, or exclusion of ambiguous cases.
